Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Android AOSP Hardware Enablement Engineer to bring up and enable automotive hardware platforms for Android Open Source Project (AOSP) and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) builds. The engineer will enable the hardware and software stack required to build, boot, and operate Android on an automotive SoC platform, covering bootloader configuration, Linux kernel integration, device tree development, vendor BSP integration, hardware driver enablement, Android build configuration, and debugging of hardware‑related boot and runtime issues. Collaboration will be required with SoC vendors, hardware teams, BSP developers, kernel engineers, and Android framework teams to deliver a stable Android infotainment platform.

Key Responsibilities

AOSP Build System and Platform Integration

  • Set up and maintain AOSP source code and development environments.
  • Configure and execute Android platform builds using Soong, Android.bp, Make, and related tools.
  • Integrate vendor‑provided Android BSP packages into the AOSP source tree.
  • Configure product definitions, device configurations, board configurations, and vendor‑specific build components.
  • Develop and maintain device‑specific build configurations (device/, vendor/, kernel integration).
  • Manage product makefiles, build variants, and system/vendor partition requirements.
  • Resolve build failures, dependency issues, missing modules, and compilation errors.
  • Maintain build scripts and documentation for repeatable platform builds.

Bootloader and Platform Bring‑Up

  • Enable the Android boot process on new or existing automotive hardware platforms.
  • Work with bootloaders such as U‑Boot or vendor‑specific implementations.
  • Configure boot arguments, image loading, memory reservations, and device‑tree handoff.
  • Coordinate with SoC vendors to resolve platform‑specific boot and firmware issues.

Linux Kernel and Device Tree Enablement

  • Integrate and configure vendor Linux kernels compatible with the selected Android release.
  • Enable required kernel configurations and device drivers for the target hardware.
  • Develop, modify, and debug Device Tree Source (DTS/DTSI) files and overlays.
  • Configure hardware resources (GPIOs, clocks, regulators, interrupts, IOMMU, DMA, memory regions).
  • Integrate vendor kernel modules and troubleshoot module loading or dependency issues.

Hardware Driver and Peripheral Enablement

  • Enable and validate peripherals required for automotive infotainment, including:
  • Display interfaces (MIPI DSI, eDP, LVDS, HDMI)
  • Touchscreen controllers and input devices
  • Audio codecs, I²S/TDM interfaces, amplifiers
  • USB host/device controllers, storage, connectivity
  • Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, GNSS, Ethernet
  • Camera interfaces and sensors
  • I²C, SPI, UART, GPIO, PCIe, other SoC peripherals
  • Automotive CAN interfaces and transceivers
  • Power management ICs, thermal sensors, watchdogs, suspend/resume

Hardware Debugging and System Validation

  • Debug the complete boot flow from bootloader to Android launcher.
  • Analyze bootloader logs, kernel dmesg, Android Logcat, tombstones, and service startup logs.
  • Use ADB, fastboot, serial consoles, JTAG, and other hardware debugging tools.

Automotive Platform Integration

  • Enable and validate Android Automotive OS on reference boards and target hardware.
  • Work with automotive SoC platforms and vendor BSPs (Qualcomm, NXP, MediaTek, etc.).
  • Coordinate with hardware design, BSP, firmware, Android framework, and application teams.
  • Support hardware variants, board revisions, and product‑specific configurations.
  • Assist with Android compatibility testing and platform validation.
  • Integrate automotive features such as vehicle properties, audio, display, connectivity, and power‑state management.
  • Follow automotive development, security, and software quality requirements.
summary: Seeking an Android AOSP Enablement Engineer to bring up platforms, handling bootloader, kernel, device tree, and integration. Collaborate with SoC vendors for Android Automotive infotainment.
